_meta.description: Named cities with population for on-globe city pins and ImpactStats human anchors (VISUAL_UPGRADE_PLAN F1).
_meta.population_basis: largest published figure for the urban area (pop_max / agglomeration)
_meta.note: mean_elev_m: DEM-derived (bake_city_elevation.py) inside flagship-metro tile coverage; hand-authored values elsewhere are carried forward by fetch_cities.py until covered.

elevation.source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (ESA/Airbus, via AWS Open Data)
elevation.method: mean of valid land cells in a ±0.005° window around the city point; water/nodata excluded
